reason: Full active master agent is minimum: documented WISHBONE bus defines 6 DUT inputs requiring driven register-selection and read/write stimulus and 2 DUT outputs requiring observation for acknowledge and read data. Passive or scaffold_only cannot program registers nor move TX/RX payload via this SoC register-access bus. This architecture choice is inferred from documented bus grouping and drive/observe map and needs review.
responsibilities: Drive wb_sel_i, wb_we_i, wb_stb_i, wb_cyc_i for transfer control and read versus write selection
Drive wb_dat_i for write data payload
Observe wb_dat_o for read data and wb_ack_o for transfer acknowledge
Provide driver plus sequencer for controlled register reads and writes and monitor for transaction reconstruction to support later register-model use
